meta.title: 0基础学化妆｜3min超详细新手保姆级遮瑕教程
meta.title_en: Zero-Base Makeup: 3-Min Full Concealer Tutorial for Beginners

scenes.title_cn: 开场：多少姐妹上遮瑕不是用手指就是刷…
scenes.title_en: Opening: how many of you dab concealer on …
scenes.context: 常见错误：乱戳+定妆后回潮。
sentences: 多少姐妹上遮瑕不是用手指就是在用刷子戳戳戳。
So many of you dab concealer with fingers or a brush.
dab concealer（戳遮瑕）
拍开之后不仅没遮住，还卡纹又卡粉。
After patting, it's not covered—plus creasing and caking.
crease and cake（卡纹卡粉）
一到定妆的环节，遮好的瑕疵又全都跑出来了。
At the setting step, the covered flaws all come back.
come back（回潮）
scenes.speak: So many of you dab concealer with fingers or a brush. After patting, it's not covered—plus creasing and caking. At the setting step, the covered flaws all come back.

scenes.title_cn: 工具选择与激活：三色或双色遮瑕盘已经…
scenes.title_en: Tool choice and activation: three-tone or …
scenes.context: 激活+摊薄是膏状遮瑕前提。
sentences: 三色或者双色的遮瑕，已经把颜色给大家调好了。
Three-tone or two-tone palettes are pre-mixed for you.
pre-mixed palette（调好的盘）
膏状的遮瑕膏用之前要先用手指揉一揉，激活一下。
Activate the cream concealer by rubbing it with a finger first.
activate（激活）
摊在手背上摊薄，再去上脸。
Spread it thin on the back of your hand, then apply.
spread thin（摊薄）
scenes.speak: Three-tone or two-tone palettes are pre-mixed for you. Activate the cream concealer by rubbing it with a finger first. Spread it thin on the back of your hand, then apply.

scenes.title_cn: 眼下遮瑕第一笔：眼睛动得多，眼下纹路…
scenes.title_en: Under-eye first touch: eyes move a lot, so…
scenes.context: 第一笔从眼尾起，粉薄不易卡。
sentences: 眼睛动得多，眼下的纹路也比较多。
Your eyes move a lot, so the creases are many.
many creases（纹路多）
如果遮瑕第一笔摁在眼头，这里的粉就会是最厚的，容易卡粉。
A first dab at the inner corner leaves the thickest product, which cakes.
thickest product（粉最厚）
所以遮瑕第一笔从眼尾开始，从后往前。
So start the first touch at the outer corner and move forward.
outer corner first（眼尾起笔）
手指有温度，拍的过程会让遮瑕和皮肤融合得更好。
Finger warmth helps the concealer blend into the skin.
finger warmth（手指温度）
scenes.speak: Your eyes move a lot, so the creases are many. A first dab at the inner corner leaves the thickest product, which cakes. So start the first touch at the outer corner and move forward. Finger warmth helps the concealer blend into the skin.

scenes.title_cn: 色斑遮法：脸上小色斑换成斜角蘑菇刷，…
scenes.title_en: Covering spots: switch to an angled mushro…
scenes.context: 色斑点戳遮，结构瑕疵后置。
sentences: 换成一把斜角的蘑菇刷，它的毛是比较密的。
Switch to an angled mushroom brush with dense bristles.
angled mushroom brush（斜角蘑菇刷）
沾好遮瑕在手背上晕一晕，然后垂直戳在有色斑的地方。
Blend on your hand, then dab vertically on the spots.
dab vertically（垂直戳）
泪沟、法令纹、嘴角凹陷这种结构型的瑕疵，放到粉底液之后来遮。
Structure-based flaws go after foundation.
structure-based flaws（结构型瑕疵）
scenes.speak: Switch to an angled mushroom brush with dense bristles. Blend on your hand, then dab vertically on the spots. Structure-based flaws go after foundation.

scenes.title_cn: 底妆后补遮：粉底拍开后，用粉扑上的余…
scenes.title_en: After foundation: use leftover powder on t…
scenes.context: 余粉融合+亮色精准补泪沟。
sentences: 粉扑上会有一些余粉，在上眼皮和下眼睑拍一拍，让遮瑕和全脸融合。
Use leftover puff powder on the lids to fuse the concealer with the face.
leftover powder（余粉）
用小刷子沾最亮的遮瑕色，精准画在眼下泪沟的地方。
A precise brush picks the brightest shade, drawn on the tear trough.
brightest shade（最亮色）
原地垂直拍开，多的余粉上下慢慢晕染过度。
Pat in place, blending the excess up and down.
blend the excess（晕开余粉）
泪沟严重就少量多次叠加，再拍开。
For deep troughs, build up in thin layers.
thin layers（少量多次）
scenes.speak: Use leftover puff powder on the lids to fuse the concealer with the face. A precise brush picks the brightest shade, drawn on the tear trough. Pat in place, blending the excess up and down. For deep troughs, build up in thin layers.

scenes.title_cn: 定妆与完成：泪沟严重不做眼下定妆，换…
scenes.title_en: Setting and finish: a deep tear trough wit…
scenes.context: 哑光高光二次提亮+定妆。
sentences: 泪沟严重不做眼下定妆，换个角度还是会看出来。
A deep trough without setting still shows from other angles.
still shows（还是看得出来）
植绒粉扑捏起一个角，沾取哑光高光，精准拍在眼下。
Pinch a velour puff corner, pick up matte highlighter, pat on the under-eye.
velour puff（植绒粉扑）
既做了二次提亮，又可以起到定妆的效果。
It brightens again and sets at the same time.
brighten and set（提亮+定妆）
远看近看都看不出什么破绽，眼下鼻翼也没有卡粉。
No tell from near or far, and no caking at the under-eye or nose.
no tell（无破绽）
scenes.speak: A deep trough without setting still shows from other angles. Pinch a velour puff corner, pick up matte highlighter, pat on the under-eye. It brightens again and sets at the same time. No tell from near or far, and no caking at the under-eye or nose.

practice: Rub the cream concealer until slightly tacky.
Start at the outer corner and work forward.
Dab vertically with an angled mushroom brush.
Cover tear troughs after foundation, not before.
Pinch a velour puff corner and pat on matte highlighter.
pitfalls: Press the first dab on the inner corner.
Start at the outer corner so the inner area stays thin.
第一笔从眼尾起，眼头粉才薄。
Color flaws first; structure flaws after foundation.
泪沟法令纹等结构瑕疵要放在粉底之后。
Dab concealer straight on without activating.
Rub it tacky and spread thin on the hand first.
膏状遮瑕不激活会卡纹卡粉。
Matte highlighter on a velour puff brightens and sets.
泪沟严重必须定妆，哑光高光二次提亮。
Build deep troughs in thin layers.
泪沟严重要少量多次叠加。
shifts: 用 activate（激活）、tacky（微粘）、spread thin（摊薄）
用 outer corner first（眼尾起笔）、dab vertically（垂直点戳）、build thin layers（少量多次）
用 color-based（颜色型）、structure-based（结构型）、tear trough（泪沟）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播。已校正：手指或刷子戳、卡纹卡粉、定妆回潮、三色双色遮瑕、膏状激活、手背摊薄、眼尾起笔、手指温度、斜角蘑菇刷、垂直戳、颜色型结构型瑕疵、泪沟法令纹嘴角凹陷、粉底液后遮、余粉融合、最亮遮瑕色、小粉扑捏起、原地垂直拍开、少量多次、植绒粉扑、哑光高光、二次提亮、定妆、鼻基底、嘴角安全位置、无破绽等。
